messages:
Maya (Demand): Heads up 1: we need final speaker bios + 2-line blurbs for the registration page by EOD Tue. Can Content + Speaker Ops sync on copy?
Eli (Content): On it. I'll draft 3 variants per speaker: short (1 line), medium (2 lines), and a technical blurb (1 sentence).
Rina (Speaker Ops): I'll collect headshots and confirm pronunciations. Also need to lock the run-of-show: 45m total, 25 demo, 10 live Q/A, 10 follow-up thread. Agree?
Nina (Host): 45m seems tight for deep benchmarks. Can we do 50m (30 demo) or keep 45 and push deep follow-ups to gated content?
Maya (Demand): Our funnel data suggests attention drops after 45m. Prefer to keep 45 and drive deep technical follow-ups via gated post-webinar doc. Tag leads as 'benchmarks' for that flow.
Tariq (Product): For the demo segment we need two timed checkpoints: t+8m (load/demo warmup) and t+18m (latency stress test). Host should have a 15s verbal cue to pivot if the test fails.
Nina (Host): I'll add those cues to the host script. Draft: "We'll now run a heavier query set; if we see delays, we'll switch to a pre-recorded demo and continue the Q&A." Thoughts?
Eli (Content): That script line is good. I'll create an alternate micro-script (20s) that sounds natural.
Rina (Speaker Ops): Rehearsal plan: 1) full run-through with mics + slide timing, 2) 10-min focused latency dry-run, 3) backup switch drill (pre-recorded + canned responses). Schedule 3 slots next Thurs.
webhook-bot: Calendar invites created: rehearsal-A 2026-04-02 09:00 PT, rehearsal-B 2026-04-04 12:00 PT, rehearsal-C 2026-04-05 16:00 PT. Invites sent to: @Maya, @Eli, @Rina, @Tariq, @Nina, speakers.
Maya (Demand): Good. On inbound routing: HubSpot form will include a "primary interest" dropdown: Benchmarks / Integration / Eval Help. We'll map Benchmarks -> SDR sequence A, Integration -> Solutions AE, Eval Help -> Eng-PS triage.
Tariq (Product): Add a hidden field for "model_size_interest" (small, medium, large) so we can score leads by compute intent. Content — include a quick checkbox on the form.
Eli (Content): Will add copy: "Which model size are you exploring? (optional)" + tooltip.
Rina (Speaker Ops): For speakers: final checklist to DM tonight: 1) bio copy 2) headshot 3) 2 backup lines if demo fails 4) phone dial-in 5) preferred name pronunciation.
Nina (Host): Also want a 30s opener that frames the benchmark narrative: "why latency & unit-cost matter for product teams". Eli, can you draft one that hooks product builders?
Eli (Content): Drafting now. Sharing in #marketing-drafts in 30m.
Maya (Demand): CTA plan: primary chat link -> registration form; secondary CTA -> benchmark deep-dive gated PDF (email collected). We'll A/B test the hero copy on registration page.
Tariq (Product): For the failover drill, Priya from Demo Engineering will run the kernel-switch script and then confirm stream continuity. Rina, please ensure Priya is in the rehearsal invites.
Rina (Speaker Ops): Priya added. Final ask: can someone run a quick accessibility check on slides (color contrast + alt text) before rehearsals?
Eli (Content): I'll run the accessibility pass and send final slides to the green-room folder.
Maya (Demand): Thanks team. I'll queue the paid social creative once bios are locked. Closing 1 :rocket:
Nina (Host): See you all at rehearsal A.
webhook-bot: Thread pinned to #marketing for visibility.
